evals.prompt: Build me a contact form with fields for name, email, and message. Include validation -- name and email are required, email must be valid. Show a submit button that shows loading state while submitting.
evals.expected_output: React form component with Input, Textarea, Button. Native event handling via e.target. Loading state on submit button. wa-stack layout.
expectations: Uses native events: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value, NOT e.detail.value or CustomEvent
Uses wa-stack or wa-gap utility classes for vertical layout
Has required prop on name and email inputs
Uses type='email' on the email Input
Has loading prop on submit Button during async submission
Wraps fields in a <form> element (not just a div)

evals.prompt: Create a login form with email and password fields. Add a 'Remember me' switch and a 'Forgot password?' link. Password field should have the toggle to show/hide.
evals.expected_output: Login form with Input type=email, Input type=password with password-toggle, Switch, and link. Proper form layout.
expectations: Uses Input with type='password' and password-toggle prop
Uses Switch component for 'Remember me' (not Checkbox)
Reads switch state via (e.target as HTMLInputElement).checked, NOT e.detail or CustomEvent
Has a <form> element with onSubmit handler
Includes npx kigumi add commands for missing components
Does NOT fabricate props like onToggle, onSwitch, or wa-change

evals.prompt: Build a settings form with two sections: 'Profile' (first name, last name, bio textarea) and 'Notifications' (email notifications switch, SMS notifications switch, notification frequency select with options Daily/Weekly/Monthly). Use a grouped layout.
evals.expected_output: Settings form with section grouping, mixed form controls (Input, Textarea, Switch, Select+Option), proper layout.
expectations: Uses Input for name fields, Textarea for bio, Switch for toggles, Select+Option for frequency
Groups fields into visual sections (headings, Details, or Card sections)
Uses wa-stack for vertical field flow
Select has Option children with value props (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)
Installs all needed components via npx kigumi add
Every form control has a label prop
